CustomField.description: The date work is planned to start - what the board calls the assigned date. A Date, not a DateTime: it is a calendar day in both source systems, and a DateTime would shift it across midnight for anyone west of Greenwich. Only sources whose Board_Source__mdt record says Supports_Start_Date__c carry one; Asana on the free tier does not, and Apex refuses one for it. Inbound sync writes it whenever a delivery carries the field, including clearing it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Planned start. Only for sources that support start dates.
CustomField.label: Start Date
